frequency_question: How often are major international river treaties renewed or successfully replaced with a successor agreement upon expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal treaties dividing transboundary river flows between two primary sovereign states that feature a fixed multi-decade duration and scheduled expiration.
window: Within the final 3 years prior to expiration

cases.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements

coverage_note: 5 named historical major transboundary water treaty renewal windows; believed roughly 8 comparable major bilateral water treaties globally in this tier.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-basin agreements and multilateral European conventions under UNECE.
validity_reason: International water law and diplomatic norms for treaty renewals evolve slowly over decades.
